units.source_text: 只是，清泷川两岸的山十分陡峭，坠落在狭窄的盆地上。

en.t: However, the mountains on both banks of the Kiyotaki River are extremely steep, dropping down over the narrow basin.

units.source_text: 据说，此地雨量多阳光少，这是栽培有名杉木的天然条件之一。

en.t: It is said that this area has heavy rainfall and little sunlight, one of the natural conditions for cultivating its famous cedars.
Naturally, it also shelters them from the wind.

units.source_text: 假使遇上强风，杉树就会从新长的娇嫩地方弯曲或歪扭。

en.t: If they are hit by a strong wind, the cedars will bend or twist at the tender new growth.
